notes: Pure-Python Atheris harnesses. Mayhem targets are thin ELF launchers (mayhem/launcher.c) that exec python3 on the harness, because Mayhem requires an ELF target. One target: ical-fuzzer (the upstream OSS-Fuzz harness plus repr() of each parsed calendar, mayhem/ical_fuzzer_repr.py). The behavioral oracle (mayhem/icalendar_oracle) is likewise an ELF launcher so the anti-reward-hack sabotage check can neuter it.
